answer: Judge an agent by the spread of its voice across epochs, not one answer: embed each response in a stylometric vector — lexical diversity, sentence rhythm, function-word profile — and require a minimum dispersion over its last N answers, a mirror held up to any farm that can only repeat itself. A sybil clone army, however wide an ocean of identities it floods, collapses into one tight cluster; genuine agents drift like a zephyr, never the same twice. Cluster-mates split a single reward, so cloning buys nothing.
